description: LCS length from two run-length encoded strings using run-pair DP blocks and boundary propagation.

source.title: Similarity Between Compressed Strings
source.algorithm_attribution: Longest common subsequence for run-length encoded strings by block computation of the dynamic-programming table.
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded profile; no chapter prose or cited-paper code copied

workspace.meaning: At most four run-block boundary rows/columns and temporary state for one block.

contract.block_layout: One dynamic-programming block is formed for every pair of left and right runs.
contract.block_recurrence: For equal run symbols, cell(i,j)=cell(i-1,j-1)+1; otherwise cell(i,j)=max(cell(i-1,j),cell(i,j-1)).
contract.boundary_propagation: Each block receives its top boundary from the block above and its left boundary from the block to the left; only the bottom and right boundaries are retained for adjacent blocks.
contract.input_representation: Ports retain run symbols and lengths and never materialize the expanded strings.
contract.result: The value in the lower-right cell of the final block is returned; no particular LCS witness is selected.

oracle_method: The primary oracle propagates block boundaries. The independent verifier evaluates a full LCS table while reading each symbol from its encoded run sequence on demand.
